context: Saito advises a patient on rest and the body.
purpose: WIDENED SCENARIO: medical advice; clinical vocabulary (身体/脳/感覚/いれ/求める) in natural home.

lines.speaker: yuki_office
lines.jp: 身体は元気なのに、頭が重いんです。
lines.en: My body's fine, but my head feels heavy.
lines.style: tired office woman voice, soft warm earnest delivery throughout

lines.speaker: saito_doctor
lines.jp: 脳が、休みを求めている感覚ですね。
lines.en: It's the sense that your brain seeks rest.
lines.style: calm doctor voice, soft warm reassuring measured clarity throughout

lines.speaker: yuki_office
lines.jp: 身体と脳は、別なんですか?
lines.style: curious office woman voice, soft warm earnest delivery throughout

lines.speaker: saito_doctor
lines.jp: ええ、別の感覚として現れます。
lines.en: Yes, they appear as different sensations.
lines.style: clear doctor voice, soft warm measured clarity throughout

lines.speaker: yuki_office
lines.jp: 力を入れすぎていたかもしれません。
lines.en: I may have been pushing too hard.
lines.style: reflective office woman voice, soft warm honest delivery throughout

lines.speaker: saito_doctor
lines.jp: 時には、力を抜く感覚も大切です。
lines.en: Sometimes the feeling of relaxing matters too.
lines.style: gentle doctor voice, soft warm caring clarity throughout

lines.speaker: yuki_office
lines.jp: 脳に、休みを入れてあげます。
lines.en: I'll give my brain some rest.
lines.style: understanding office woman voice, soft warm delivery throughout

lines.speaker: saito_doctor
lines.jp: 身体が求める声を、聞いて下さいね。
lines.en: Please listen to what your body asks for.
lines.style: warm doctor voice, soft warm caring closing clarity throughout
